description: IRA owner born in 1945, age 80 in 2025.
worked:
IRA owner born 1945-05-01; age attained on the 2025 birthday = 2025 - 1945 = 80. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Born before 1951: the required beginning date passed under the earlier law (age 70 1/2 for anyone born before July 1, 1949; age 72 for anyone born July 1, 1949 through 1950); distributions are required every year, including 2025.
Uniform Lifetime Table (26 CFR 1.401(a)(9)-9(c)), age 80: distribution period 20.2.
RMD = account balance at December 31, 2024, 350,000 / 20.2 = 17326.7327, rounded to the cent = 17,326.73.
